name: chotot-cli
description: Command-line client, market-price analyser and MCP server for Chợ Tốt (Vietnam classifieds)

commands.search: Search listings by keyword, category, province, district, price, condition, seller type
commands.detail: One listing in full: specs, location, seller, images, active status
commands.analyze: Asking-price distribution with percentiles, per-condition breakdown and histogram
commands.seller: A seller's complete live inventory and asking-price summary
commands.shop: A professional shop's profile (phone numbers redacted unless --show-contact)
commands.facets: List the probe-verified search filters a category supports
commands.regions: Province and district codes, including 2025 merger groups
commands.export: Write results to CSV, JSON or Markdown
commands.doctor: Re-measure the upstream API contract against the live gateway
commands.mcp: Serve the Model Context Protocol over stdio
